retrievalProfile.description: A desaturated, multi-exposure composition featuring a sharp foreground subject against a ghosted, repetitive background of the same figure in various poses.

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex layered portrait where a primary subject in the lower right foreground is anchored by a large, high-key, desaturated montage of the same individual filling the upper two-thirds of the frame. The scene is set in an urban environment with a chain-link fence and graffiti, unified by a hazy, light-leaked color palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground subject scale vs. background montage scale
Sharp foreground focus vs. soft-edged background transparency
Clean sans-serif typography vs. expressive marker-style script
Cool blue tones in foreground vs. warm light-leaks at the edges
coreInvariants: Cowboy hat as a recurring motif
Presence of a chain-link fence mid-ground
Teal and magenta chromatic aberration at the frame edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is small-scale, seated in the bottom right quadrant; background montage is large-scale, filling the top and center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The seated figure in the bottom right provides the only high-contrast, sharp-focus point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the sharp foreground figure, moves upward to the large ghosted faces, and finally to the centered typography at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High-key white areas between the ghosted figures act as breathing room for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated whites and light grays in the background montage.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy and charcoal in the foreground subject's clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan and magenta light-leak fringes at the extreme corners.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value (brightness) in the background to create a dreamlike effect.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to muted earth tones and washed-out blues

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed sans-serif and expressive brush script
letterConstructionRules: Top line: All-caps, high-waisted, condensed sans-serif with wide tracking
Bottom line: Slanted, gestural script mimicking a permanent marker
Script features varying line thickness and rounded terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'C' in the script has an exaggerated top hook
The 'M' in the script is constructed with two distinct peaks
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A rigid, clean sans-serif paired with a chaotic, organic script for a 'structured vs. personal' contrast.

preserve: The contrast between the two font styles

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, clean feel of the top line
Captures the raw, gestural energy of the main title

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-key, desaturated double-exposure image of a man in a cowboy hat. Place a sharp, seated version of him in the bottom right. Fill the rest of the frame with ghosted, semi-transparent versions of his face and torso. Include a chain-link fence and urban textures with light leaks at the edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered text at the top. The first line should be a clean, condensed sans-serif in white. The second line should be a large, black, marker-style script.

verificationChecks: Is the background sufficiently faded to allow text legibility?
Does the foreground subject stand out through sharpness and darker values?
Are the light leaks present only at the edges?
Is the script text bold and gestural?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Exact graffiti tags on the wall

avoid: Hard edges on the ghosted background figures

postGenerationChecks: Verify the double-exposure effect looks integrated, not just layered.
Check that the color palette remains desaturated and cool-toned.
Ensure the text is centered and follows the established hierarchy.
Confirm the cowboy hat is a consistent element across all exposures.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a sharp, small-scale foreground subject with a large, high-key, multi-exposure background of the same subject, unified by light leaks and a mix of clean and gestural typography.
